interpretation_notes: The argument commits the fallacy of affirming the consequent (S → V and V does not entail S), but this is a structural observation unrelated to translation fidelity. Propositional logic was chosen because all claims can be represented as atomic propositions without requiring quantifiers or predicates. The domain description 'All individuals' is required by the schema but not semantically relevant in propositional logic.
